explorer.intro: Your app listing is your store's page in the Frak app, where customers can discover your store.

purchaseTracker.title: Order tracking
purchaseTracker.description: Frak needs to know about your orders to pay rewards. A webhook is a message your shop sends to Frak when an order changes. Connect your shop here.

sheet.description: Choose your shop software, then follow the steps. Frak then receives your orders.
sheet.registerHint: Once the URL and secret are in your shop, click Connect. Keep this panel open until then.

change.title: Change shop software?
change.description: Order tracking can stop until the new connection is saved.
change.internalWarning: You cannot go back from this dashboard. To reconnect, set up the connection again from the Frak app for Shopify or the Frak plugin for WordPress.

instructions.shopify: In your Shopify admin, open <italic>Settings > Notifications > Webhook</italic>. Create a webhook for the <italic>Order Updated</italic> event and paste the URL below. Shopify then shows a signing key at the bottom of the webhooks list. Paste that key in the field below, then click Connect.
instructions.woocommerce: In your WordPress admin, open <italic>WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > Webhooks</italic>. Create a webhook with the topic <italic>Order Updated</italic>. Paste the URL and the secret below, then click Connect.
instructions.magento: To connect Adobe Commerce (Magento 2), ask your developer to install the <doc>frak-labs/magento2-module</doc> package. Then open <italic>Stores > Configuration > Frak > Webhook Secret</italic> in your Magento admin and paste the secret below.
instructions.custom: For a shop built by a developer. Give this page to your developer, who can follow the <doc>documentation</doc>.
instructions.internal1: Your orders already reach Frak. This usually means you use the Frak app for Shopify or the Frak plugin for WordPress. Nothing to do.
instructions.internal2: If this looks wrong, choose your shop software above to set up the connection yourself.

draw.title: Draw

bank.title: Frak bank

bank.closedHint: The bank is closed: nothing is paid until it reopens.

recheck.hint: Settlement re-checks a refilled bank every 3 hours. After a top-up, re-check now to pay what it can cover right away.
